import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

source = Path('products/services/software-awards/raw/ocds-105743-2026.json')
raw = source.read_bytes()
package = json.loads(raw)
release = next(item for item in package['releases'] if item['id'] == '105743-2026')
contract = next(item for item in release['contracts'] if item['status'] == 'active' and item['id'] == '105743-2026-PROC 26-3336-1')
award = next(item for item in release['awards'] if item['id'] == contract['awardID'])
lot = next(item for item in release['tender']['lots'] if item['id'] in award['relatedLots'])
supplier = next(item for item in award['suppliers'] if item['id'] == 'GB-FTS-188234')
party = next((item for item in release.get('parties', []) if item['id'] == supplier['id']), {})
uri = (party.get('contactPoint') or {}).get('url')
parts = urlsplit(uri) if isinstance(uri, str) else None
origin = f'{parts.scheme}://{parts.hostname}' if parts and parts.scheme in {'http', 'https'} and parts.hostname and not parts.username and not parts.password else None
result = {'source': str(source), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'release_id': release['id'], 'contract_id': contract['id'], 'award_id': award['id'], 'lot_id': lot['id'], 'lot_description': lot.get('description'), 'supplier': supplier, 'supplier_origin_in_award': origin, 'evidence_limit': 'The award establishes the contract-to-lot linkage. A listed origin is a retrieval lead. Current paid subcontract intent and response instructions require supplier evidence.'}
output = Path('products/services/awarded-supplier-qa/supplier-source-pointer.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'supplier': supplier['name'], 'lot_id': lot['id'], 'supplier_origin_in_award': origin}, ensure_ascii=False))
